subject: general
question: Which hypothesis was proposed by Paul Ehrlich to suggest the importance of species richness in the maintenance of ecosystems?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rivet popper hypothesis.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Rivet popper hypothesis:-**

 
 
• This hypothesis suggests that species in an ecosystem are like rivets in an airplane, and if too many are lost, the entire system can collapse.
 
• Paul Ehrlich proposed this hypo
